_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the cube set. Edit this file, then run scripts/gen_cubes.py to regenerate the per-cube URDFs (+ meshes/textures). The workflows read this file at runtime (mounted as /data/cubes.json) for the cube list, size, colors and numbers, so nothing about a cube is defined twice. See scripts/gen_cubes.py and examples/ur/cube_catalog.py.
_render_mode: How the number is shown on the cube faces in sim. 'texture' = a generated PNG (color + digit) UV-mapped onto a cube mesh (arbitrary numbers/labels, needs the sim renderer to display mesh textures -- verify with the spike). 'pips' = die-style dots built from URDF boxes (URDF-native, no texture support needed, best for 1..9). 'box' = plain colored box, no number (the original look).
